I'll pull your order up now.

Victor, Shop···· is your replacement Hammer Thor P2, paid at $0 and reserved at our Chattanooga warehouse. It's still on hold, because the system releases it the moment your BS-2 is checked in there, and the return hasn't been booked in on our side yet.

Our warehouse record shows nothing received from you yet, so it's the check-in that's lagging, not the delivery. The team has that and will confirm with you directly. Once it's checked in, the Thor P2 ships and you get tracking by email.
